description.p: A desktop tracker for swing traders who manage positions in R multiples. Every buy is its own lot with an initial stop and a 25% sell ladder. The app shows the current stop and the next target for each position, suggests stop raises and tranche sells at each milestone, and raises alerts.

ul.li: Spreadsheet-style positions table with expandable trades
Performance statistics: win rate, profit factor, expectancy and R / StDev
Prices, sectors, earnings dates and dividends from the internet, with manual overrides
Candlestick charts with stop, target and R-ladder lines
Automatic local backups, restore, and JSON export and import
